name: US Medical Records
description: US medical records and clinical notes. Detects patient names, dates of birth in every common format, Medical Record Numbers (MRN — 6+ digit runs without decimals), SSN, full US street addresses, ZIP codes, emails and US phone numbers. Preserves lab values by ignoring numbers with commas/periods and short runs (under 5 digits).

patterns.name: Medical Record Number (MRN)
patterns.description: 6+ contiguous digits with no adjacent digit, period or comma. Preserves lab values like 12.4 or 1,234.56 and short numbers under 5 digits.

patterns.name: Social Security Number (SSN)
patterns.description: US SSN — XXX-XX-XXXX format. 9-digit undashed SSNs are covered by the MRN pattern above.

patterns.name: Date (MM/DD/YYYY or MM-DD-YYYY)
patterns.description: US date — MM/DD/YYYY or MM-DD-YYYY, 4-digit year 1900-2099

patterns.name: Date (DD Month YYYY)
patterns.description: Alt long-form date — '5 January 1980' or '5 Jan 1980'

patterns.name: US phone number
patterns.description: US phone with explicit formatting. Bare 10-digit runs excluded: they collide with Medical Record Numbers
